health-psychology-gas.alt: A curve of resistance to stress over time while a stressor continues, against a dashed line at the normal level. 1, Alarm: resistance briefly dips below normal at the shock, then sympathetic arousal begins. 2, Resistance: resistance rises well above normal and stays high while the body copes at a cost, with hormones and arousal kept up. 3, Exhaustion: reserves run down, resistance falls below normal and the person becomes more vulnerable to illness. A model curve, not data from one study.
